name: codex-auto-resume
description: Automatically resume interrupted OpenAI Codex work and prime rolling quota windows after reset.

commands.title: Codex Auto Resume: Test Official Submit Bridge (Legacy)
Codex Auto Resume: Test Official UI IPC Bridge
Codex Auto Resume: Diagnose Official Codex Integration
Codex Auto Resume: Enable Quota Primer
Codex Auto Resume: Disable Quota Primer
Codex Auto Resume: Show Quota Primer Status
Codex Auto Resume: Prime Quota Now
Codex Auto Resume: Reset Quota Primer Thread

codexAutoResume.enabled.description: Automatically resume a recently interrupted VS Code Codex thread after its usage limit resets.

codexAutoResume.resumePrompt.default: 继续。从中断处恢复，先检查当前工作区已有修改和上一轮状态，不要重复已经完成的工作。
codexAutoResume.resumePrompt.description: Prompt sent when the extension resumes an interrupted Codex thread.

codexAutoResume.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh Codex usage state while auto resume is enabled.

codexAutoResume.resetGraceSeconds.description: Extra delay after the reported reset time before resuming.

codexAutoResume.resumeStabilitySeconds.description: How long a resumed turn must remain in progress without a quota error before auto-resume considers it stable and disarms. Completed turns disarm immediately.

codexAutoResume.recentThreadMinutes.description: Only arm auto-resume for VS Code Codex threads updated within this many minutes. The default covers a full 5-hour quota window plus margin.

codexAutoResume.codexCommand.description: Optional Codex executable override. When empty, the binary bundled with the official openai.chatgpt extension is preferred.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.enabled.description: Prime dormant Codex quota windows after reset. Enable this on only one local/remote extension host for the same Codex account.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.primaryEnabl.description: Prime the primary rolling quota window (normally the 5-hour window) after its reset.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.secondaryEna.description: Prime the secondary rolling quota window (normally the weekly window) after its reset.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.pollInterval.description: How often Quota Primer checks Codex rate-limit windows.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.graceSeconds.description: Delay after a tracked quota reset before deciding that the new rolling window is still dormant.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.jitterSecond.description: Random preflight delay before a primer request. This reduces duplicate primers when multiple VS Code windows are running.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.prompt.default: Quota window primer. Reply exactly OK. Do not inspect files, run tools, or modify anything.
codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.prompt.description: Minimal prompt sent only in the dedicated Quota Primer conversation.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.modelPrefere.description: Preferred low-cost model name or substring for Primer turns. The extension resolves it dynamically with model/list and falls back if unavailable.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.reasoningEff.description: Reasoning effort for Primer turns. Use 'lowest' to select the cheapest supported effort automatically, or provide an explicit effort name.

codexAutoResume.quotaPrimer.allowModelFa.description: Allow Quota Primer to use a different model if the preferred low-cost model is unavailable. Disabled by default to avoid unexpectedly expensive primer requests.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run check && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3.6.0 package --readme-path README.extension.md --out codex-auto-resume.vsix
